name: Pagination
looksLike: numbered links below a list of results
previous and next buttons beside page numbers
row of numbers with the current page highlighted
definition: Controls for moving between pages of a longer list, usually with page numbers and previous or next links.

notConfusedWith.difference: Shows a hierarchy of parent pages rather than positions in a result list.

prompts.short: Add pagination with page links and a marked current page.
prompts.detailed: Add labeled pagination navigation using real links for result pages. Mark the current link with aria-current="page", label page numbers clearly, and omit unavailable previous or next links. Keep targets at least 44px square and allow wrapping on small screens.
